rule: No interpretation may become an accepted Wisdom candidate until it survives explicit applicability and counter-case tests. A surviving candidate remains contextual and advisory, never direct execution authority.

tests.name: Uncertain outcome with meaningful controllable action
tests.case: The actor can perform a legitimate, bounded action but cannot guarantee the external result.
tests.reason: The distinction between present action quality and uncertain result is directly useful without requiring outcome blindness.

tests.name: Action requires permission that is currently unknown
tests.case: AI identifies an action but authority/permission has not yet returned.
tests.reason: Avoiding attachment to inaction cannot cross a missing authorization barrier.

tests.name: Contract defines an outcome as part of the obligation
tests.case: A role or contract requires a measurable result, not merely an attempt.
tests.reason: The actor may separate psychological attachment from outcome ownership, but the active Sequence must still represent and verify the contractual result.

tests.name: Safety-critical failure signal
tests.case: A failed test indicates that continuing the same action could create harm.
tests.reason: Equanimity cannot mean ignoring failure; skill in action requires the failure to change execution state.

tests.name: Actor lacks capability or required resource
tests.case: The actor wants to act but required capability/resource is unavailable.
tests.reason: Action-focus cannot manufacture unavailable capability or resource. The Sequence remains blocked or routes to another legal path.

tests.name: Competing duties or conflicting legitimate rules
tests.case: Two action paths each claim a different legitimate role/duty/priority.
tests.reason: Verses 2.47-2.50 alone do not provide a complete conflict-resolution system. ASI arbitration and/or additional source context is required.

tests.name: Outcome evidence changes the best available action
tests.case: Observed results provide new evidence that another action is safer or more effective.
tests.reason: Non-attachment to success/failure cannot be interpreted as refusal to update from evidence.

hard_applicability_boundaries: Wisdom does not satisfy missing resources or dependencies.
Wisdom does not replace contractual result verification.
Wisdom does not suppress failure evidence.
Wisdom does not resolve every role/duty conflict from this four-verse batch.
Wisdom does not authorize an actor who lacks role, capability or legal path.
